questions.question: In the 4-digit aluminum system, what does the first digit identify?
questions.explanation: The first digit identifies alloy type.

questions.question: What does the second digit in the 4-digit aluminum system indicate?
questions.explanation: The second digit indicates modification of the alloy.

questions.question: What do the third and fourth digits indicate in the 4-digit aluminum system?
questions.explanation: The third and fourth digits indicate aluminum purity.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series is commercially pure aluminum?
Which aluminum alloy series uses copper as its main alloying element?
questions.explanation: Copper alloys are in the 2XXX series.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series uses manganese?
questions.explanation: Manganese alloys are in the 3XXX series.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series uses silicon?
questions.explanation: Silicon alloys are in the 4XXX series.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series uses magnesium?
questions.explanation: Magnesium alloys are in the 5XXX series.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series uses magnesium and silicon?
questions.explanation: Magnesium-and-silicon alloys are in the 6XXX series.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series uses zinc?
questions.explanation: Zinc alloys are in the 7XXX series.

questions.question: Which aluminum alloy series is used for other elements?
questions.explanation: Other elements are grouped in the 8XXX series.

questions.question: How is cast metal formed?
questions.answerText: Molten metal poured into a mold
questions.explanation: Cast metal is made by pouring molten metal into a mold.

questions.question: What does wrought mean?
questions.explanation: Wrought metal is worked into shape.
